LightningComponentBundle.description: Configurable detail section. Build its configuration in the Section Config Builder (/lightning/n/ND_Section_Config_Builder) and paste the result into Field JSON Configuration.

property.name: ND_jsonConfigString
property.label: Field JSON Configuration
property.description: BUILD THIS AT /lightning/n/ND_Section_Config_Builder — the Section Config Builder composes this whole value visually: field rows, section title, icon picker, colour pickers, layout, header alert, plus a live preview of this component and validation that catches misspelled keys. Build it there, click Copy JSON, paste it here. Hand-editing works but is unvalidated: a mistyped key does nothing and reports nothing on the page, only to the browser console.
